in_arabic.name: جسمينة
in_arabic.meaning: مركبة من الشجرة الزيتونية المفرودة بالعسل
in_arabic.long_meaning: A compound name derived from the Arabic word 'jasm' (زيتون) meaning olive tree and the word 'nin' (نن) meaning new or young. The name Jasmina thus refers to a new and young olive tree.

in_urdu.name: جسمینہ
in_urdu.meaning: از رود زیتون و کفرنیت شکسته شده
in_urdu.long_meaning: A compound name in Urdu derived from the words 'jas' (زیتون) meaning olive tree and 'mina' (مینا) meaning crushed. The name Jasmina thus refers to the crushed olive tree.

in_hindi.name: जस्मिना
in_hindi.long_meaning: A compound name in Hindi derived from the Sanskrit word 'jas' (जस) meaning radiant or shining and 'mina' (मिना) meaning apple or jasmine flower. The name Jasmina thus refers to a radiant apple or jasmine flower.

in_pashto.name: ژاسمينه
in_pashto.long_meaning: A compound name in Pashto derived from the Persian word 'jas' (زیتون) meaning olive tree and the suffix '-mina' (مینا) meaning written or inscribed. The name Jasmina thus refers to a written olive tree.
